data.narrative:
Twenty is a Series A-stage Defense & Security company that has raised $38M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer set of 4 private Defense & Security firms at equivalent stage, supplemented by 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and additional private benchmarks including Anduril Industries.

Two triangulation methods were applied. The stage-progression method, using total capital raised as a proxy for current value, applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement, yielding $76M. The peer-median approach references four same-sector, same-stage companies—Stark Defence ($4.0B), Castelion ($1.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M)—producing a median valuation of $700M. The peer range spans $125M to $4.0B, reflecting considerable variance in the Defense & Security category at this stage.

The triangulated analysis yields a median valuation of $388M, with a supportable range of $65M (floor) to $805M (ceiling). The wide dispersion reflects meaningful uncertainty around whether Twenty's positioning and growth trajectory align with lower-end peers like NODA AI or higher-performing competitors. Key valuation drivers include technology differentiation, customer acquisition traction, and defensibility within the defense sector—factors not fully captured in stage-based progression alone.
